title: Perfect
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Fantastic walking tour! We had a wonderful time exploring the city and discovering its history, culture, and hidden gems. Our guide was absolutely amazing – knowledgeable, friendly, enthusiastic, and engaging. The stories were interesting, and the atmosphere was relaxed and enjoyable. A perfect way to discover the city! Highly recommended!
author: Go35333568121

title: Best Tour in Seville
text: An exceptional tour with Fernando! Simply spectacular and speechless. Highly knowledgeable professional historian who communicated exceptionally well and conveyed all the information to us. He is very knowledgeable and friendly and we enjoyed the tour and loved every bit of it. We learnt so much with precise information and we felt transported with his unique style of storytelling with passion and enthusiasm. I would highly recommend anyone to book with Fernando. He communicated with us prior to meeting and made it very easy for us to meet him. Loved all his recommendations. Thank you for part
author: 412salmani

title: An interesting tour providing insight into the city's history
text: Valentin was a great guide. Passionate about his city and its history. We saw lots of impressive buildings finishing in the Place de espagne which is magnificent. Also passed some great tapas spots which we very much enjoyed later.
author: relaxedholidaygoer

title: Sevilla Walking tour
text: Excellent walking tour of a beautiful city. Guide was outstanding, spoke fluent English, and very knowledgeable about the history of the city and country.
author: Doug_F

title: Very interesting
text: Pleasant and intense, Fernando knows a lot about Sevillian history
author: 568jesush

title: A really good historical guide to Seville
text: This was an informative and interesting tour, with a guide who knew far more than just the sights he showed us.
author: BenW365

title: Historical walk through Seville
text:
First of all, thanks to Lidia, our guide.
Thank you for your kindness and professionalism. Highly recommended to learn a little bit about this beautiful city that offers so many incredible stories. If you are looking to enjoy a pleasant and cultural time, do not hesitate to do it with her.
author: K2957FCraulg

title: Essential guided tour
text: The visit with Fernando was very pleasant; the guide is very competent and passionate, and he takes great care to explain the historical background of Seville and Andalusia to you in great detail.
author: lety_paolini

title: What you do not know about historical Seville
text: We loved Fernando, if you like history he is the ideal guide, thank you very much for showing us part of your culture
author: T7478ADsusanag

title: Amazed by the history of Seville!
text: Fernando was our guide, he provided us with excellent chronological information and historical context for each of the eras at the different sites of interest, he also uses visual aids through digital and/or printed images, which helps a lot; he was always very attentive to the group and ready to answer any questions. Very kind and professional. 100% recommended.
author: kathezuvi
